title: Scheduled tasks saved by an earlier version are gone in new signed-in sessions after 2.1.329
symptoms: Tasks created before the upgrade no longer run in a fresh session
Scheduled task list looks empty or missing entries until you resume the original session
cause: 2.1.329 changed how saved scheduled tasks are handled. In new signed-in sessions, most tasks saved by earlier versions are not picked up and must be scheduled again. Only --resume of the session that owns them still runs them.
fix: Recreate the scheduled tasks in the new version, or resume the original session with --resume if you need the old ones to keep running for now.
apply: claude --resume  # pick the session that owned the old scheduled tasks, or re-create them with /loop or the scheduling command
affected: Claude Code 2.1.329 and later, for tasks saved by 2.1.328 or earlier
